data.desc: Modexus Solutions develops thermal innovations that lead the pace of progress. Since 1916, we have been the go-to partner in thermal management, enabling customers to reach new frontiers through engineering excellence, proprietary technologies, and collaborative systems design. Driven by the dedication of more than 9,000 employees worldwide, our portfolio of advanced commercial HVAC and data center cooling solutions delivers breakthroughs that accelerate societal progress and advance our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World. Modexus Solutions is a global company headquartered in Wisconsin (U.S.), with manufacturing and technology centers across North America, Europe, and Asia.
